# Will my IRIS 1099 bulk upload be accepted?

> Free IRIS 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC CSV checker: finds bad TINs, invalid SSNs, state and ZIP errors, money formats, below-threshold amounts and duplicate recipients with line numbers, and applies safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
